chapter.verse: Tua ahih manin Topa' tawldamna sung lut theih nading kamciam pen tu dong hinglai ahih sam hangin note' lakah a lut zolo na omkhak ding uh lau-in kidawm ni.
A hang pen amau' kiangah Lungdamna Thu a tun dan lianin eite' kiangah zong hong tung hi a, ahi zongin amaute in upna tawh thu a ngaite pawlpih lo uh ahih manin tua thu in amaute phattuamna pia lo hi.

Thu a um eite i hihleh tawldamna sung i lut a, tua pen a nuai-a bangin ama' gen ngeisa thu ahi hi: “Hehna tawh ka kiciam mah bangin, ‘Amaute keima' tawldamna sung lutkha lo ding uh hi.’ ” A lutkha lo om ahih hangin ama' nasepte pen leitung kilamkip hunin a kizo khin ahi hi.
A hang pen amah in mun khat ah hih bangin ni sagihni thu na gen hi: “Tua ciangin Pasian pen ni sagihni-in a nasepte khempeuh pan tawlnga hi.”
Himah taleh hih bangin na kigelh leuleu hi: “Amaute keima' tawldamna sung lutkha lo ding uh hi.”
Tua hi a, mi kimkhat lutkha ding ahih hangin tu ma-a Lungdamna Thu a za ngei khinte ahihleh a thumanlohna uh huhau-in lutkha lo ding uh hi.
Tua banah sauveipi khit ciangin amah in David' kam zangin a tunga kigensa kammalte tawh, “Tuni,” a kici ni a tuam khat, seh hi: “Tuni-in ama' awging na zak uhleh na lungsim uh khauhsak kei un.”
A hang pen tua mite Joshua in tawldamsak khin hileh a nung ciangin Pasian in ni a dang khat thu, gen laizang lo ding hi
Tua hi a, Pasian' mite' adingin Sabbath tawldamna khat a omlai ahi hi.
Tua hi a, Pasian pen ama' nasepna pan tawlnga ahih mah bangin Pasian' tawldamna sung a lut mi peuhpeuh nasepna pan a tawlnga khin ahi hi.
Tua ahih manin a tunga thumanlohna nam tawh a pukkha kuamah i om loh nadingin tua tawldamna sung i lut zawh nading hanciam ni.

A hang pen Pasian' thu nungta-in a gamtang hi a, langnih-hiam namsau sangin hiamzaw-in nunna kha leh sungtawng kha kikal, guhletang leh cintuiguh kikal pailetin khenkhia hi. Lungsim ngaihsutnate leh ngimna tupnate zong khentel thei hi.
Pasian' mai-ah piansak nate a kiliah cih bang om lo a, thulela i telgenkik nadingpa ahi ama' mit nuai-ah na khempeuh ahi bangin kipholakin om hi.
Jesu, Pasian' Tapa, vantungte a nawksa siampi lianpenpa a lianpi khat i neih khit nungsang i pulak upna thu kiptak len cinten ni.
Eite' neih siampi lianpenpa pen i thanemnate hong lainatpih theilo nam hilo-in eimah tawh kibangin siatzolna namkim a thuak, ahih hangin mawhna a bawllo, siampi lianpenpa ahi hi.
Tua hi a, kitangsapna i neih simin thukhualna ngahkha-in hehpihna i sankhak nadingin sunglam kimuanna tawh hehpihna tokhom va zuan ni.
